title: Middle-aged aunt’s self-driving life
simplified_paragraphs: 1964年，苏敏出生于西藏，后来她跟随家人来到了河南学习和生活，成为了一名工人。
她曾经也渴望通过婚姻改变自己的生活，但是事与愿违，后面漫长的几十年婚姻生活却让她的生活变得更艰难。和当时的大多数女孩一样，苏敏经过别人介绍，认识了现在的丈夫。结婚前，因为丈夫在外地工作，他们只见过两次面，吃过两顿饭。结婚一年后，她就怀孕生下了女儿。
后来因为失业，她当了一段时间的家庭主妇。也是这一段家庭主妇的经历让她发现丈夫对钱斤斤计较，于是她开始打工赚钱。那段时间，她白天要照顾孩子、做家务，晚上出去工作，几乎每天都在凌晨出门，早上六点回家。即使她开始赚钱，丈夫依然非常挑剔，他们的婚姻也变成了AA制婚姻。36岁时她与丈夫分居了。
苏敏的前半生看起来并不幸福。直到2019年，她无意中看到一个关于自驾游的网络视频，仿佛打开了新世界的大门。因为无法忍受丈夫和不幸福的生活，她决定开始全国自驾游，成为一名旅游博主。

2020年，苏敏开始了自己的自驾游旅程。只有在路上，她才是她自己，不再是别人的妻子、妈妈、外婆。她的旅程也非常自由，去了100多个城市，认识了很多新朋友，生活越来越充实，笑容也越来越多。这一路的旅游经历都被苏敏用镜头记录下来并发布在网络上，也引起了大家的关注。随着她越来越有名，除了退休工资，她也有了旅游博主的额外收入。2022年，苏敏买了一辆房车，她说自己终于拥有了人生中第一个完全属于自己的家。她的经历也鼓舞了很多网络上的陌生人，让他们有勇气去追求自己的生活。
为了女儿，那么多年苏敏一直选择忍耐，没有想过离婚，可是丈夫的行为一次次地伤害着她。即使在她患重度抑郁症期间，丈夫也没有丝毫改变。现在，她终于决定要离婚了，女儿和女婿也表示支持她的决定。
苏敏走过了更远的路，认识了更多的人，也看见了更大的世界，终于变成了自由的她。

pinyin_paragraphs: 1964 nián， Sū Mǐn chū shēng yú Xī zàng， hòu lái tā gēn suí jiā rén lái dào le Hén án xué xí hé shēng huó， chéng wéi le yī míng gōng rén。

tā céng jīng yě kě wàng tōng guò hūn yīn gǎi biàn zì jǐ de shēng huó， dàn shì shì yǔ yuàn wéi， hòu miàn màn cháng de jǐ shí nián hūn yīn shēng huó què ràng tā de shēng huó biàn de gèng jiān nán。 hé dāng shí de dà duō shù nǚ hái yī yàng， Sū Mǐn jīng guò bié rén jiè shào， rèn shi le xiàn zài de zhàng fu。 jié hūn qián， yīn wèi zhàng fu zài wài dì gōng zuò， tā men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn， chī guo liǎng dùn fàn。 jié hūn yī nián hòu， tā jiù huái yùn shēng xià le nǚ ér。

hòu lái yīn wèi shī yè， tā dāng le yī duàn shí jiān de jiā tíng zhǔ fù。 yě shì zhè yī duàn jiā tíng zhǔ fù de jīng lì ràng tā fā xiàn zhàng fu duì qián jīn jīn jì jiào， yú shì tā kāi shǐ dǎ gōng zhuàn qián。 nà duàn shí jiān， tā bái tiān yào zhào gù hái zi、 zuò jiā wù， wǎn shang chū qù gōng zuò， jī hū měi tiān dōu zài líng chén chū mén， zǎo shang liù diǎn huí jiā。 jí shǐ tā kāi shǐ zhuàn qián， zhàng fu yī rán fēi cháng tiāo ti， tā men de hūn yīn yě biàn chéng le AA zhì hūn yīn。36 suì shí tā yǔ zhàng fu fēn jū le。

Sū Mǐn de qián bàn shēng kàn qǐ lái bìng bù xìng fú。 zhí dào 2019 nián， tā wú yì zhōng kàn dào yī gè guān yú zì jià yóu de Wǎng luò shì pín， fǎng fú dǎ kāi le xīn shì jiè de dà mén。 yīn wèi wú fǎ rěn shòu zhàng fu hé bù xìng fú de shēng huó， tā jué dìng kāi shǐ quán guó zì jià yóu， chéng wéi yī míng lǚ yóu bó zhǔ。

2020 nián， Sū Mǐn kāi shǐ le zì jǐ de zì jià yóu lǚ chéng。 zhǐ yǒu zài lù shang， tā cái shì tā zì jǐ， bù zài shì bié rén de qī zi、 mā ma、 wài pó。 tā de lǚ chéng yě fēi cháng zì yóu， qù le 100 duō gè chéng shì， rèn shi le hěn duō xīn péng you， shēng huó yuè lái yuè chōng shí， xiào róng yě yuè lái yuè duō。 zhè yī lù de lǚ yóu jīng lì dōu bèi Sū Mǐn yòng jìng tóu jì lù xià lái bìng fā bù zài Wǎng luò shàng， yě yǐn qǐ le dà jiā de guān zhù。 suí zhe tā yuè lái yuè yǒu míng， chú le tuì xiū gōng zī， tā yě yǒu le lǚ yóu bó zhǔ de é wài shōu rù。2022 nián， Sū Mǐn mǎi le yī liàng fáng chē， tā shuō zì jǐ zhōng yú yōng yǒu le rén shēng zhōng dì yī gè wán quán shǔ yú zì jǐ de jiā。 tā de jīng lì yě gǔ wǔ le hěn duō Wǎng luò shàng de mò shēng rén， ràng tā men yǒu yǒng qì qù zhuī qiú zì jǐ de shēng huó。

wèi le nǚ ér， nà me duō nián Sū Mǐn yī zhí xuǎn zé rěn nài， méi yǒu xiǎng guo lí hūn， kě shì zhàng fu de xíng wéi yī cì cì de shāng hài zhe tā。 jí shǐ zài tā huàn zhòng dù yì yù zhèng qī jiān， zhàng fu yě méi yǒu sī háo gǎi biàn。 xiàn zài， tā zhōng yú jué dìng yào lí hūn le， nǚ ér hé nǚ xu yě biǎo shì zhī chí tā de jué dìng。
Sū Mǐn zǒu guo le gèng yuǎn de lù， rèn shi le gèng duō de rén， yě kàn jiàn le gèng dà de shì jiè， zhōng yú biàn chéng le zì yóu de tā。
english_paragraphs: Su Min was born in Tibet in 1964. Later, she followed her family to Henan to study and live, and became a worker.

She once longed to change her life through marriage, but it backfired and the long decades of marriage made her life more difficult. Like most girls at that time, Su Min met her current husband through someone else's introduction. Before getting married, because her husband worked out of town, they only met twice and had two meals. A year after her marriage, she became pregnant and gave birth to a daughter.

Later, due to unemployment, she became a housewife for a period of time. It was also this period of experience as a housewife that made her realize that her husband cared about money, so she started working to make money. During that time, she had to take care of her children and do housework during the day, and go out to work at night. She would go out in the early morning almost every day and return home at six in the morning. Even when she started making money, her husband was still very picky and their marriage became an AA marriage. At the age of 36 she separated from her husband.

Su Min's first half of life seemed unhappy. Until 2019, she accidentally saw an online video about a self-driving tour, which seemed to open the door to a new world. Because she couldn't stand her husband and unhappy life, she decided to start a self-driving tour across the country and became a travel blogger.

In 2020, Su Min started her own self-driving journey. Only on the road is she herself, no longer someone else's wife, mother, or grandmother. Her journey was also very free. She visited more than 100 cities and met many new friends. Her life became more and more fulfilling and she smiled more and more. The travel experience along the way was recorded by Su Min and posted on the Internet, which also attracted everyone's attention. As she became more and more famous, in addition to her retirement salary, she also had additional income as a travel blogger. In 2022, Su Min bought an RV. She said that she finally had the first home in her life that was completely her own. Her experience has also inspired many strangers on the Internet, giving them the courage to pursue their own lives.

For the sake of her daughter, Su Min had chosen to be patient for so many years and never thought about divorce. However, her husband's behavior hurt her again and again. Even during her severe depression, her husband did not change at all. Now, she finally decided to get a divorce, and her daughter and son-in-law also expressed their support for her decision.
Su Min traveled a farther distance, met more people, and saw a bigger world, and finally became a free woman.
